findings.value: A queer club in Dalston, open since 2009, that also works as a cabaret space, cafe, gallery and community space. The venue says its weekend drag brunch has a cult following.

evidence.quote: Functioning in equal parts as a thriving queer club, cabaret spot, cafe, gallery and community space
The venue first slid open its rainbow shutters in 2009
Our weekend Drag Brunch has gained cult-status

findings.value: The venue says it is a queer space that caters to London's LGBTQ+ community.

as much a thriving music-centred club as it is a front-running drag and performance space

findings.value: Music-led club nights alongside drag and performance shows, and a weekend drag brunch.
